what_happened: The retry of the job that stops writing Athena- trailers after cutover C0 was rejected. 1 of 8 acceptance criteria was unmet, with 2 major findings. No failed checks are listed. The unmet criterion is the `cargo test` end-to-end scratch-repository test. It must build pre-C0 history that passes the old rules, with a job landed the old way with trailers and then C0. It must then build one job branch holding an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing commit, and land it via land_pr with a squash merge. The first finding says the test has no job landed the old way, and its landing commit skips the real writer. The second says the new post-C0 branch of retry_landing in run.rs has no test. The other 7 criteria were met.
cause: Nothing in code makes the producer check, before handover, that each criterion has a test matching its stated fixture shape. It also does not check that every changed code path has a covering test. This is the same gap the first attempt (20261025-012657-hac3) was rejected for, and the retry fixed some of it but still left the fixture short and one writer (retry_landing) untested. A change to shared landing and history behavior has several writers and readers, and nothing lists them and maps a test to each. Only the verifier's judgment at the final verdict catches this, and there rejection is the only outcome. This is an inference, since the stored fields do not show what the producer ran or wrote.
prevention: Add a pre-handover check, run by code, that the producer must pass before it can hand over. For a change to landing or history code, the producer lists every writer and reader of the changed path (land_pr, retry_landing, reconcile, check_history, status, auditor). It maps each to a named test, and the check confirms every named test exists and passes. For each criterion that names a fixture shape, the check also confirms the test builds each named element and goes through the real writer, not a hand-built stand-in. The check fails the handover rather than leaving it for the verifier's final verdict.
proposed_request: Retry of the job that stops Athena- trailers in commits after cutover C0, narrowed to closing the two test gaps from the last rejection. Do not change the behavior already accepted. Outcomes: (1) A scratch-repository test builds pre-C0 history: a bootstrap commit, a job landed the old way with Athena- trailers, then the cutover job as C0. It then builds one job branch holding an intervention commit (commit_with_staged), a records-only commit (Committer) and the job landing commit produced by the real post-C0 writer, not a hand-built commit. It lands the branch via land_pr with a squash merge. The test asserts that check_history and check_attribution pass on the result and that the squash commit carries no Athena- trailers. (2) A test covers the post-C0 branch of retry_landing in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs and asserts that it writes the landing record without Athena- trailers. Acceptance: both tests exist and fail if the behavior they cover is removed. The change description lists each caller and writer of the changed landing path with its covering test and cites the commands actually run. cargo clippy --all-targets, cargo fmt --check and cargo test are clean for the workspace.
